description: Adm Linker Manifest — maps every file in the SRS repository to the Admissible Behavior Set (Adm) rules it implements, enforces, or tests. This manifest is the mathematical linkage required by the Final Constraint: every line of code and every configuration file must be linked to Adm.

adm_definition.Adm_spatial: ∀ d, p . write_request(d, p) ⇒ admissible_write(d, p)  [Chapter 7.2]
adm_definition.Adm_thermal: ∀ j . low(θ_j) ≤ F_j ≤ high(θ_j) ∧ θ_APU+θ_RPU ≤ 1.05 ∧ θ_FPGA+θ_NISQ ≤ 1.00 ∧ Σ F_j ≤ G ∧ Σ F_j·(1−θ_j) ≤ Q_BAR  [Chapter 7.4]
adm_definition.Adm_behavioural: (i, c, a, r) ∈ Adm iff R1(op/tier well-typedness) ∧ R2(context compatibility) ∧ R3(proof coverage) ∧ R4(SEG certification)  [Chapter 7.6]

files.description: Enforces spatio-temporal isolation via TI/SC page attributes and TIB token budgets. admissible_write() implements Adm_spatial; grant_hypercall() implements Adm_temporal.
SMPU/SPPU drivers enforce per-domain memory and peripheral access permissions derived from the Omnivisor's TI/SC attributes. NISQ_CAL_BUS and FPGA_JTAG require SEG certification.

Unified Telemetry Bus feeds hardware-level invariants (power, ECR gate errors) into the agent decision loop, which is governed by Adm_thermal. Every eBPF program is an AdmissibleMutation requiring SQA quorum.
AgeMem controller with 6 ops (ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, RETRIEVE, FILTER, SUMMARY) and Step-wise GRPO. decide_adm() implements the Adm-gated re-sampling loop (Adm rule R1-R4).
Adm-gated GRPO trainer (k=2) with SL bonus (+0.15) for DELETE tombstoning and Evidence Fabrication penalty (-1.0) for inadmissible chains. Operationalises Adm as a non-differentiable constraint.
Adm I×C×A×R relation evaluator. Implements rules R1 (op/tier well-typedness), R2 (context compatibility), R3 (proof coverage), R4 (SEG certification). 6 demonstration cases all pass.

Generates the GRPO advantage map correlating DELETE/FILTER actions with thermal-safety envelope restoration. The contention-shaped reward (+0.25 FILTER red-herring, +0.15 DELETE tombstone) aligns the policy with Adm.
ESR Persistence Schema v2.0. Defines evidence_chain (intent→context→action→reasoning) as a required field, plus bls_evidence_binding and seq for SEG verification.
Fully-populated v2.0 ESR entry demonstrating evidence_chain, BLS evidence binding, and seq epoch.
Quantum-Thermal Contention reconciliation log. Documents Verifiable Semantic Rollback (3 STM beliefs pruned), 3-of-4 SQA quorum, BLS evidence binding.

Z3 power-thermal proof in 4 modes: nominal, high-entropy, thermal-derating, contention-resolution. Certifies low(θ_j) ≤ F_j ≤ high(θ_j) with ε ≥ 0.05 margin. The contention-resolution mode binds RPU frequency to ESV and safety margin to QPU noise-floor.
TLA+ specification proving deadlock-freedom across APU/RPU/FPGA boundaries. Theorems: BudgetInvariantTheorem (safety), NoDeadlockTheorem (liveness under AdmCostCheck), NoStarvationTheorem (fairness).

Generates SystemVerilog Assertions from declarative safety invariants. Enforces Adm_thermal (power envelope, thermal coupling) and I2C protocol invariants at the RTL level. Used by the Saarthi formal validator.
Generated SVA module (output of saarthi_sva_generator.py). Loaded into hardware model checkers to verify RTL against Adm invariants.
AdaQC DP-based NISQ circuit compiler. Switches to depth-reduction mode when θ_FPGA > 0.85 × high(θ_FPGA), the Adm_thermal trigger threshold. Every compiled circuit is an AdmissibleMutation.

Multidimensional photonic bus emulator (102 Tbps aggregate). Fed by VDD_OPT power rail whose thermal envelope is certified by the Z3 proof (Adm_thermal). ESR replication packets are AdmissibleMutations.
Semantic Quorum Assurance aggregator. Enforces risk-adaptive quorum threshold, heterogeneous-validator diversity, and c_sum ≥ c_min. Implements Adm rule R4 (SEG certification).
BLS aggregate signature module. Cryptographically binds (validator_id, c_i) pairs to the Z3 witness hash, ensuring non-repudiation. Implements the evidence-binding primitive required by Adm rule R3.

Sovereign Execution Gate admission controller. Performs 5 checks: evidence_chain.admissible, seq epoch, SQA quorum, Z3 witness hash binding, sqa_certificate_ref resolution. The final authority on whether a mutation may take effect.
Digital DNA encoder. Every artefact committed to the SRS carries a 256-bit DNA strand. The Antibody Repertoire scans DNA against known-defective patterns; matches trigger the CI/CD refactoring loop.

Antibody Repertoire with Affinity Maturation. Seeds known-defective patterns, records TP/FP outcomes, spawns mutated variants for finer-grained matching. Feeds the heuristic validator in the SQA quorum.

summary.coverage: Every file in the repository is linked to at least one Adm rule. The Adm_behavioural rule (I×C×A×R relation) is the most widely linked, reflecting its role as the cognitive-layer complement to the state-level Adm_spatial/temporal/thermal rules.
